object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: In the Project Explorer, open in turn: a folder holding a document but no git repository; a document folder inside a git work tree; the root of a repository with one commit that git records as shallow. Then, with a repository open, open one of its document folders. Expected: each folder is refused and no document is listed. The first reason says the folder is not inside a git repository and how to clone or create one. The second says the folder is not the root of its git work tree and 'Open <work tree root> instead.', naming the root, with no advice to run git init. The third gives git fetch --unshallow as the only remedy. The last shows in a message box naming the root, and the repository that was open stays listed.
